tests.title: Sticker reply is recorded as a non-text answer
tests.goal:
Reply with a WhatsApp sticker

Verify that a sticker reply is counted once and is identified as a non-text answer in reply statistics and the downloaded report.
preconditions: An admin account and an approved WhatsApp template are available.
The receiving phone can send a WhatsApp sticker.
The receiving contact has been sent the template and has no recorded reply.
data: Use only the designated WhatsApp test phone.
Reply with one sticker without text or a caption.

steps.text: Log in with your admin account and open the sent template.
On the receiving phone, reply with one WhatsApp sticker before sending any text or tapping a reply button.
Open 回覆統計 (Reply statistics) and inspect the contact’s answer.
Download the reply report and inspect the answer cell for the contact.

expected.text: The sticker counts as one reply under Other or a clearly labelled media category.
The displayed answer and report identify that the member sent a sticker or non-text media, rather than a blank or unexplained answer.

notes: One approved send delivered to designated test phone. One inbound image/webp attachment with empty Body arrived via our ngrok webhook (200), counted once under Other. UI and exported 回覆紀錄!K6 show only 其它, no sticker/media label; 數據統計 counts 1. User asked to keep contact/reply/upload. No resend or cleanup.

User clarified that generic Other is expected for sticker/image replies. Original failed check reflected the earlier media-label expectation, not a product defect. BUG-046 is wont-fix; case expectations updated. The received attachment was counted once and exported as Other. No new execution or outcome rewrite.

Sticker test through our ngrok tunnel. Single send only; real media reply received and counted, but no sticker/media label in UI or report (BUG-046). All test data retained at user request. No other reply types were tested.
